concepts.name: Realm Management (online-beratung)
concepts.summary: realm.json carries the 'online-beratung' realm definition — clients, roles, and auth settings. Since July it is Helm-templated ({{ .Values.global.keycloakAuthServerUrl }} / adminDomainName placeholders in redirect URIs and web origins), binds directGrantFlow to the custom 'direct-grant-2fa' flow, sets emailTheme 'oriso', and adds a confidential 'user-service' client with service accounts enabled. Realm roles include restricted-agency-admin (added June 2026); there is NO global-support role in this repo's export at the pinned commit.

concepts.name: Custom ORISO Keycloak Image (26.6.3-otp)
concepts.summary: This repo owns the custom Keycloak image: stock quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.6.3 plus the vendored otp-config SPI jar and the 'oriso' email theme, published by CI as ghcr.io/openresilienceinitiative/oriso-keycloak:26.6.3-otp (plus dev/pre-dev branch tags and release/keycloak-* release tags). The ORISO Helm chart references the published image only; SPI source, theme, and build workflow live here.

concepts.name: OTP Config SPI (vendored, ADR-013)
concepts.summary: Vendored fork of Onlineberatung/onlineberatung-keycloak-otp (AGPL, commit fbafb2b), ported to Keycloak 26.6.3. Exposes /realms/<realm>/otp-config/** REST endpoints that the UserService calls for 2FA setup (fetch-otp-setup-info, setup-otp, delete-otp, send-verification-mail, setup-otp-mail); callers must present a bearer token holding the realm role 'technical'. Also registers the direct-grant authenticators app-authenticator (TOTP challenge JSON) and email-authenticator (login-time email OTP).

concepts.name: Email OTP Credentials (MAIL_OTP)
concepts.summary: MAIL_OTP credential type with its own CredentialProvider/Factory. The July 2026 'code not matching' fix registered the MailOtpCredentialProviderFactory as an SPI (it previously was not, so the verify hop found no credential and returned 400), purges pending-but-unverified credentials on resend, deletes all mail OTP credentials on teardown, and sends the verification mail through a UserModelDelegate so the account email is not persisted before the OTP is verified.

concepts.name: direct-grant-2fa Authentication Flow
concepts.summary: Custom top-level direct-grant flow: validate-username → validate-password → conditional sub-flows app-otp-conditional (conditional-user-configured, app-authenticator, direct-grant-validate-otp) and email-otp-conditional (conditional-user-configured, email-authenticator with email-otp-config). Bound as the realm's Direct Grant Flow in realm.json for fresh imports; scripts/keycloak-apply-2fa-flow.sh applies it idempotently to existing realms via kcadm, preserving the existing email-otp-config id from the execution row.

concepts.name: ORISO Email Theme (generated from design system)
concepts.summary: The 'oriso' Keycloak email theme (otp-email and password-reset templates, de/en message bundles, orisoPlatformName/color/URL theme properties) is GENERATED from the ORISO-Frontend email design system ('npm run emails:keycloak') and copied in via scripts/sync-email-theme.sh — do not edit by hand. Theme lookups carry their own defaults so an operator can override any property per realm. The same theme also lives in ORISO-Helm; both copies must be synced or one silently wins at deploy time.

concepts.name: Legacy Kubernetes Manifests (caritas namespace)
concepts.summary: keycloak-deployment.yaml / keycloak-service.yaml / ingress.yaml are the LEGACY raw manifests (still pin quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:20.0.5 in start-dev mode with inline admin credentials). Current deployments come from the ORISO-Helm chart referencing the custom 26.6.3-otp image; these manifests and DEPLOYMENT.md/STATUS.md describe the old single-node setup and have not been updated.

concepts.name: HTTP Access Mode (SSL requirement disabled)
concepts.summary: Keycloak requires HTTPS by default; in ORISO, nginx terminates TLS and internal services talk HTTP. configure-http-access.sh must run after every deployment to disable the SSL requirement for all realms, otherwise authentication fails with 'HTTPS required'. realm.json itself still declares sslRequired=external; the script flips the live realm.

concepts.name: Realm Backup
concepts.summary: backup/realm-backup.sh exports the 'online-beratung' realm from the running Keycloak pod (kubectl exec) into timestamped backups in the repo's backup directory.

flows.name: 2FA Setup via otp-config REST
flows.summary: UserService (technical-role bearer token) calls /realms/online-beratung/otp-config/**: fetch-otp-setup-info returns secret/QR data, setup-otp activates app TOTP, send-verification-mail generates a MAIL_OTP credential and emails the code, setup-otp-mail verifies it and activates email OTP, delete-otp tears everything down (all mail OTP credentials, not just the default).

flows.name: Email OTP Login (direct grant)
flows.summary: Password grant hits the direct-grant-2fa flow → email-otp-conditional → email-authenticator: without an otp param it generates a code (MemoryOtpService), sends it via the realm's SMTP settings using the oriso otp-email template, and returns the otpType challenge JSON; with an otp param it validates and completes the grant. App TOTP takes the parallel app-otp-conditional branch via app-authenticator and the stock validate-otp.

flows.name: Image Build & Publish
flows.summary: CI (feature/PR/main workflows plus a release/keycloak-* release workflow) builds the otp-config SPI with Maven, assembles the Dockerfile (SPI jar into /opt/keycloak/providers, themes into /opt/keycloak/themes, kc.sh build), and pushes ghcr.io/openresilienceinitiative/oriso-keycloak tags (26.6.3-otp, dev, pre-dev, release tags). Helm consumes the published image only.

flows.name: Email Theme Sync from Design System
flows.summary: Change email copy/design in ORISO-Frontend src/emails → 'npm run emails:keycloak' generates the Keycloak flavour (message-bundle copy, Keycloak model variables; see ADR-020) → scripts/sync-email-theme.sh copies dist/keycloak/email into keycloak-image/themes/oriso/email → rebuild image; the twin copy in ORISO-Helm must be synced with its own script.

flows.name: Apply 2FA Flow to Existing Realm
flows.summary: For realms that predate the 2FA flow: kubectl exec into the Keycloak pod (must run the oriso image) → keycloak-apply-2fa-flow.sh logs kcadm in, rebinds directGrantFlow to stock 'direct grant', captures the existing email-otp-config id from the execution row (flat JSON, parser-safe), deletes and recreates direct-grant-2fa with both conditional sub-flows, restores the config, and rebinds the realm.

flows.name: Deploy & Configure (legacy path)
flows.summary: Legacy raw-manifest path: apply deployment/service/ingress → wait for the pod → run configure-http-access.sh to disable the SSL requirement. Current deployments instead go through the ORISO-Helm keycloak chart with the custom image; the HTTP-access step remains relevant wherever nginx terminates TLS.

flows.name: Backup & Restore Realm
flows.summary: realm-backup.sh exports the realm from the running pod to a timestamped file; realm.json is the canonical import used to restore or re-provision the realm (now containing Helm placeholders, so it must be rendered/substituted before a raw import).
